# `irs527_expenditures`

**IRS Form 8872 Schedule B expenditures**

Itemized expenditures (record type B) reported on IRS Form 8872 Schedule B in PolOrgsFullData.zip, retaining literal amounts, dates, and ISO-8859-1 text.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All Schedule B expenditure records present in the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_expenditures.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
